analysis_en.detailed_summary: The current bundle uses this title for device permission prompts, and nearby copy mentions allow, deny, and a window screenshot. The actual requested capability must be read on the prompt.

analysis_en.summary: Allow {app} to access this device? asks whether to grant the named app device access.
analysis_en.what_it_means: You decide whether the named app may use the access described in the prompt.
analysis_en.what_to_do: Review the app name and requested capability, and allow it only if intended.
